source_interpretation.title: Proposed phase transfer, reduction and recovery
source_interpretation.text: The authors describe a liquid ethanol/linoleic-acid phase, solid sodium linoleate and a water/ethanol phase containing Ag ions. They propose Ag-ion exchange into silver linoleate, reduction by ethanol at interfaces, outward-facing alkyl chains and gravity-assisted phase separation. These are the paper’s mechanism interpretation; silver linoleate, ligand coverage and phase compositions were not directly measured.
source_interpretation.source_locator: Supplied PDF p. 2, hydrothermal preparation and mechanism

source_interpretation.title: Particle cores and assembled monolayers are distinct
source_interpretation.text: The TEM specimen shows round, smooth Ag particles, a reported diameter of 5.0 ± 0.3 nm and ordered arrays on a carbon-film/Cu support. The ± statistic is unspecified. The authors interpret the smooth packing as diffusion outpacing arrival during grid drying; it does not establish a measured diffusion coefficient or a separate synthesis.
source_interpretation.source_locator: Supplied PDF pp. 2–3, TEM method, Figure 1 and packing discussion

source_interpretation.title: Surface identity remains unresolved
source_interpretation.text: The preparation and Figure 2 discussion describe linoleic-acid passivation, while Figure 1 and the interlinking discussion refer to sodium linoleate tails. Both descriptions are kept as source-proposed context; neither is a measured bound-ligand structure or a resolved identity assignment.
source_interpretation.source_locator: Supplied PDF pp. 2–3, Figure 1 caption, passivation and Figure 2 discussion

source_interpretation.title: Spacing and weak plasmon absorption
source_interpretation.text: The source reports a center-separation/particle-diameter ratio D/2r of approximately 1.75. It associates weak plasmon absorption with small particle cores and ordered separation. No absolute interparticle gap, shell thickness, quantitative coupling constant or absorption-peak wavelength is inferred.
source_interpretation.source_locator: Supplied PDF pp. 3–4, Figure 3 and D/2r discussion

source_interpretation.title: PL explanation is a hypothesis
source_interpretation.text: The measured 390 nm PL band is obtained with 250 nm excitation on quartz. The authors propose radiative sp-electron/d-hole recombination enhanced by a combination of surface plasmon and an electrostatic mechanism analogous to SERS. This source does not supply its own Raman measurement, absolute PL quantum yield or time-resolved mechanism test.

source_interpretation.title: Cited variations do not become new recipes
source_interpretation.text: Temperature control of core size, alternative fatty-acid/sodium-stearate combinations and electronic transitions appear as cited discussion, including an unpublished reference. No separate source-defined charge, temperature series or measured conductivity outcome is supplied here.
source_interpretation.source_locator: Supplied PDF p. 3, cited size and ligand variations; p. 4, reference 12

missingness: Four supplied PDF pages comprise one publisher cover and three complete main-article pages. SI and cited full sources remain unreviewed.
Reagent purity/grade and silver-nitrate stock preparation are unreported; the stated aqueous concentration and charged volume do not establish stock preparation or a measured yield.

Autoclave material/liner, pressure, gas composition, heating ramp, mixing, cooling rate, wash procedure and storage are not reported. No washing or additional drying step is inserted into product recovery.
The source gives 5.0 ± 0.3 nm but does not define the ± statistic. It is not silently converted into a range or a standard deviation.

TEM samples are deposited from ethanol onto carbon films on Cu grids under ambient conditions; optical PL samples are on quartz. Exact aliquot and physical-batch links across these measurements are not supplied.
The source alternates between proposed linoleic-acid passivation and sodium-linoleate-tail interlinks. Molecular surface identity and coverage are not directly measured or silently reconciled.
Fatty-acid/sodium-stearate substitutions and size-temperature control are cited or unpublished discussion, without separately reported current-source recipes.
No measured atomic coordinates, absolute PL quantum yield, exact textual plasmon peak wavelength or current Raman/electrical measurement is reported. Figure curves are preserved without digitization.
Source-specific molecular geometries, unit cell and particle models remain presentation pending. Authored apparatus diagrams are conceptual and source-bound.
